title: MemberService.register
description: Parses the name and email, refuses a taken email and inserts the member, in one transaction. It saves `MemberRegistered` to the outbox in that transaction and runs the relay once it commits.

title: ToolService.add
description: Parses the name, trims the description and inserts the tool in good condition, in one transaction. It saves `ToolAdded` to the outbox in that transaction and runs the relay once it commits.

title: ToolService.reportDamage
description: Parses the note and sets the tool to needs repair in one transaction, leaving any loan alone. It saves `DamageReported` to the outbox in that transaction and runs the relay once it commits. The librarian's endpoint and the event handler TL-LEND-PO01-H both invoke it.

title: ToolService.markRepaired
description: Refuses a tool that does not need repair, then sets it to good and clears the note, in one transaction. It saves `ToolRepaired` to the outbox in that transaction and runs the relay once it commits.

title: LendingService.borrow
description: Runs the checks in order in one transaction and inserts the loan with its due date. It saves `LoanOpened` to the outbox in that transaction and runs the relay once it commits.

title: LendingService.return
description: Requires a valid condition, refuses a second return, records the return and reports whether it was late, in one transaction that touches only the loan. It saves `ToolReturned` to the outbox in that transaction and runs the relay once it commits, which hands the event to TL-LEND-PO01-H; the return stands whatever that handler does, and an event whose handler fails stays undelivered for the next relay run.
